docs.title: Cobblemon Trainer's Satchel
docs.text:
Not released yet

The Trainer's Satchel has no public download yet. These pages describe the current development build, 0.0.20: seven pockets with tag-based sorting and server rules, three tiers, sorting and slot locks, keep-on-death, a battle lock with optional limits, evolution hints, planting from the bag, a PokeBelt refill, the bag drawn on your back, and an unlimited item storage behind every Cobblemon PC, shared by Soul Link partners.

docs.title: Cobblemon Trainer's Satchel
docs.text:
A trainer's bag, not a backpack. The Satchel sits on your back and gives every kind of item its own pocket: Poké Balls, medicine, evolution stones, seeds, building blocks, drops and key items, so the Ultra Ball is always where you left it.

MC 1.21.1 Fabric NeoForge Not released yet Cobblemon 1.8+

Get started Pockets & rules

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• 🎒 Seven pockets: each takes only its own kind of item, and anything else bounces back.
  • 🏷️ Sorted by tags: items from any mod land in the right pocket, and operators can send any item to the pocket they choose, in game.
  • ⬆️ Three tiers: Canvas Satchel, Leather Explorer Bag and Ultra Satchel, from 14 to 42 slots per pocket, upgraded without losing what is inside.
  • 🔢 Sorting and slot locks: from the Explorer Bag up.
  • ⚔️ Battle rules: during a Cobblemon battle only the battle pockets open, with optional per-battle limits.
  • ✨ Evolution hints: stones and held items your party can use right now glow in their pocket.
  • 🌱 Plant from the bag: seeds, saplings and berries, without leaving the Agriculture pocket.
  • 🎯 PokeBelt refill: the satchel restocks the ball you just threw.
  • 💾 Keep it on death: by default you never lose the bag or what is inside it.
  • 🧍 On your back: each tier is a different 3D bag, dyeable, with a cosmetic slot on the Ultra Satchel.
  • 🖥️ Storage at every PC: an unlimited item storage, divided by pockets, behind every Cobblemon PC, shared between Soul Link partners when Cobblemon Nuzlocke is installed.
  • ⚙️ Tuned in game with /satchel config, no restart needed.

docs.title: Get it
docs.text:
Version 0.0.19 Minecraft 1.21.1 Side Server and every player's game Cobblemon 1.8+ — 1.7.x is not supported Fabric Accessories, Fabric API, Architectury API, Fabric Language Kotlin NeoForge Accessories, Architectury API, Kotlin for Forge Optional PokeBelt: when you throw the belt's last ball of a kind, the satchel refills it (Fabric only) · Cobblemon Action Combat: its real-time fights close the battle pockets and its throws refill from the satchel · Cobblemon Nuzlocke & Soul Link: players in one Soul Link share one PC item storage

No public download yet. New here? Start with Getting Started.

docs.title: Commands & Configuration
docs.text: Every command is under /satchel, for operators only.

docs.title: /satchel rules reload
docs.text: Re-reads config/cobblemon_trainers_satchel/item_rules.json after a hand edit and updates every player. A broken file is never overwritten, and the rules in force stay (Pockets & Rules).

docs.title: /satchel config
docs.text:
Shows and changes every setting on a live server. A change applies to everyone at once, without a restart, and is written to config/cobblemon_trainers_satchel/config.json so it survives one.

Command What it does /satchel config Lists every feature with its settings and the allowed values. /satchel config <feature> Lists one feature. /satchel config <feature> enabled <true\|false> Switches the feature on or off. /satchel config <feature> <setting> <value> Sets one of its numbers or choices.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
config.json holds an enabled switch for every feature, plus these settings. A broken file is never overwritten, and the settings in force stay.

Feature What enabled false does Settings pockets The satchel does not open and open screens close. canvas_slots 14, explorer_slots 28, ultra_slots 42 (each 7 to 63) classifier Every pocket takes any item; the Rules button hides. sort Sorting and slot locks off for everyone. death Deaths are left to the game (Keeping It on Death). death_rule: PROTECTED (default), BOUND_ITEM or VANILLA battle The battle lock and both limits off. balls_per_battle 0, items_per_battle 0 (0 = unlimited) evo_indicator No evolution hints. planting No planting from the bag. belt_refill No PokeBelt refill. cosmetics No bag drawn on the back, cosmetic slot hidden; what is in it stays. pc_storage The PC opens straight to Cobblemon's PC; what is stored stays. soul_link_shared true: with Cobblemon Nuzlocke, one storage per Soul Link; false gives everyone their own again

All features are on by default.

docs.title: Community Credits
docs.text:
The Trainer's Satchel is built on the work of others:

  • Cobblemon, whose Pokémon, party and PC the satchel works with.
  • Accessories (Wisp Forest), the back slot the satchel is worn in.
  • PokeBelt, whose belt the satchel refills.
  • Cobblemon Action Combat, whose real-time fights the battle lock follows.

Found a bug or have an idea? Post it in the Discord.

docs.title: Keeping It on Death
docs.text:
Dying never costs you the satchel by default. The setting death death_rule picks what a death does, for every tier alike, and is read at each death, so a change applies to the next one:

Rule What a death does PROTECTED (default) Every satchel the death would drop is handed back on respawn, into your inventory, with everything in it. It is saved with the world, so quitting on the death screen or a server restart loses nothing. BOUND_ITEM A single bag is left still at the spot where you died. Lava, fire, explosions and time never destroy it; only the void takes it. VANILLA The vanilla rule: the bag drops and spills its contents with the rest of your items, and the cosmetic slot goes with them.

This works for a bag in the inventory, the offhand or the Accessories back slot. A grave mod that keeps items without dropping them keeps the bag too.

/satchel config death enabled false leaves deaths entirely to the game: the bag drops whole.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: The Trainer's Satchel targets Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric and NeoForge, with Cobblemon 1.8. It goes on the server and on every player's game.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
Dependency Notes Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric Loader or NeoForge the jar for your loader Fabric API Fabric only Fabric Language Kotlin or Kotlin for Forge the one for your loader Architectury API both loaders Cobblemon 1.8.0+ 1.7.x is not supported Accessories 1.1.0-beta.54+ the back slot the satchel is worn in

Optional: PokeBelt (Fabric only), so the satchel can refill the belt's balls, and Cobblemon Action Combat, whose real-time fights the battle lock follows too. With Cobblemon Nuzlocke, players in one Soul Link share their PC item storage.

With an older version of a required mod the game refuses to start and names the mod and the version it needs.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Install Cobblemon, Accessories and the libraries for your loader.
  2. Drop the Trainer's Satchel jar for your loader into mods/, on the server and on every player's game. Never put both loaders' jars in.
  3. Craft the Canvas Satchel: string, wool and leather (Tiers).
  4. Right-click it to open the seven pockets, or wear it in the Accessories back slot.

Nothing is ever picked up into the satchel on its own: you put items in, by shift-clicking them from your inventory or by dropping them on a pocket's slots (Pockets & Rules).

docs.title: In a battle
docs.text:
While you are in a Cobblemon battle (wild, trainer or PvP) the satchel keeps to battle things. Agriculture, Architect and Materials close: their tabs grey out ("Closed during a battle"), they cannot be opened or filled, and the server refuses to open them. Poké Balls, Medicine, Evo & Held and Key & Utility stay open. The pockets open again as soon as the battle ends, however it ends.

Cobblemon Action Combat's real-time fights count as battles too, when that mod is installed.

Operators can also cap what one battle may take out of the satchel:

Setting Pocket Default battle balls_per_battle Poké Balls 0 (unlimited) battle items_per_battle Medicine 0 (unlimited)

Past the cap the item snaps back with an action-bar line, and the count starts again with each battle. It counts items taken out of the satchel, not items used, through every way out: pickup, shift-click, number keys, cursor swaps, throwing and double-click collect.

/satchel config battle enabled false turns the lock and both limits off.

docs.title: Evolution hints
docs.text:
In the Evo & Held pocket, an item one of your party Pokémon can use right now glows green. Its tooltip names who and how:

  • "Eevee can evolve with it": a stone, used on the Pokémon.
  • "Happiny evolves holding it": an Oval Stone.
  • "Pikachu gets its held-item effect": Light Ball, Metal and Quick Powder, Leek, Deep Sea Tooth and Scale, Eviolite for anything that can still evolve.

The glow shows even when another requirement is not met yet, and the tooltip then says what is missing ("needs level 25", "needs friendship 160"). It follows your party live while the bag is open.

/satchel config evo_indicator enabled false turns it off.

docs.title: Planting from the bag
docs.text:
With the satchel in your offhand and your main hand empty, right-click farmland, dirt or grass: it plants the first seed, sapling, berry or apricorn seed from the Agriculture pocket that grows there, one at a time. Right-click on air still opens the bag; bone meal and hoes stay in your hands.

Wearing the bag on your back instead, press , (comma; rebindable under Controls) while looking at the soil. Sneak + , picks which plant goes first.

Nothing plants during a battle, when Agriculture is closed. /satchel config planting enabled false turns it off.

docs.title: PokeBelt refill
docs.text:
From the Leather Explorer Bag up, Fabric only. Wear PokeBelt and the satchel, and when you throw the belt's last ball of a kind, a stack of that same kind moves from the Poké Balls pocket into the belt slot. It never puts a different ball there; with none of that kind left, the slot stays empty. It works for Cobblemon Action Combat's throws too, and in a battle the refilled balls count against battle balls_per_battle.

PokeBelt is Fabric only. Without it the log says once that the refill is off. /satchel config belt_refill enabled false turns it off.

docs.title: PC Item Storage
docs.text: Behind every Cobblemon PC there is a place to keep items.

docs.title: Using it
docs.text:
Right-click a Cobblemon PC and it first asks: Pokémon or Items.

  • Pokémon opens Cobblemon's own PC, with your party and boxes, with all of Cobblemon's own checks.
  • Items opens your item storage.

The storage is yours: the same at every PC in the world, and nobody else's. It has the satchel's seven pockets as tabs and no limit: each kind of item is one cell with its total (1.2k, 34k, the exact number in the tooltip), with pages when a section holds more than 42 kinds.

Action Result Put an item on a cell stores the whole stack Right-click with an item stores one Shift-click an item in your inventory stores it, in the open section if that takes it, otherwise in its own pocket's Left-click a cell takes a stack Right-click a cell takes half a stack Shift-click a cell takes a stack into your inventory

It is saved with the world, so it survives a restart, and it closes when you walk away from the PC. The cells are a view of the storage, never real slots, so no more than a stack leaves at a time.

docs.title: Soul Link: one storage for the team
docs.text:
With Cobblemon Nuzlocke installed, players in one Soul Link share one item storage at every PC, titled Soul Link Storage.

  • Signing the link pours everyone's storage into the shared one, with the counts added. A player who joins the link later brings theirs.
  • What one stores, the others see at once, even with the storage open at the same time.
  • A player who leaves the link (restarting their run) starts with an empty storage; the rest keep the shared one.
  • When the link ends, the last member keeps the shared storage as their own.

Without the Nuzlocke nothing changes: everyone has their own storage.

/satchel config pc_storage soul_link_shared false turns the sharing off: each player sees only their own storage, and the shared one waits untouched until it is switched back on.

docs.title: Switching it off
docs.text: /satchel config pc_storage enabled false removes the question: the PC opens straight to Cobblemon's PC. What is stored stays.

docs.title: Pockets & Rules
docs.text: Right-click the satchel to open it. It has seven tabs, one per pocket, and each pocket takes only its own kind of item. Put anything else in and it bounces back, with the slot flashing red.

docs.title: The seven pockets
docs.text:
Tab Pocket id What goes in Poké Balls poke_balls Poké Balls Medicine & Restores medicine potions, restores, revives, remedies, ethers Evo & Held Items evo_held evolution items and held items Agriculture & Farming agriculture berries, apricorns, seeds and saplings Architect & Building architect building blocks Materials & Drops materials crafting materials and mob drops Key & Utility Items key_utility key and utility items

The contents live on the bag itself, so they survive closing it, dropping it and picking it up again. Shift-click an item in your inventory to send it straight to its pocket.

docs.title: Which pocket an item goes to
docs.text:
1. An operator's rule, if the item has one. A rule sends the item to one pocket, or to none, which keeps it out of every pocket.
  2. Otherwise the pocket tags cobblemon_trainers_satchel:pocket/<pocket id>, which a datapack can edit. This is how items from other mods land in the right place without any setup.

A rule always wins over the tags. Remove the rule and the tags decide again.

docs.title: The Rules screen
docs.text:
The Rules button on the satchel's title row lists every item with its pocket, filterable by mod or id. (tag) marks an item the tags decide; ▸ marks one a rule decides. A click moves an item to the next pocket.

Everyone sees the rules; only an operator can save. Save writes config/cobblemon_trainers_satchel/item_rules.json on the server and updates every player at once.

You can also edit the file by hand:

{"rules": {"minecraft:stick": "materials", "minecraft:bone": "none"}}

and run /satchel rules reload (Commands). A file that is not valid JSON is never overwritten: the rules already in force stay.

Switch the whole sorting system off with /satchel config classifier enabled false: every pocket then takes any item and the Rules button hides.

docs.title: Tiers
docs.text:
Item Recipe Slots per pocket Unlocks Canvas Satchel string, wool, leather 14 the seven pockets Leather Explorer Bag a Canvas Satchel + 6 hides + 2 copper ingots 28 sorting and slot locks, the PokeBelt refill Ultra Satchel an Explorer Bag + 2 diamonds + 2 netherite scrap or shulker shells 42 the cosmetic slot

"Hides" are leather, rabbit hide and anything tagged #c:leathers (cobblemon_trainers_satchel:hides); the Ultra materials are tagged cobblemon_trainers_satchel:ultra_materials. A datapack can add to both.

Upgrading keeps the bag's contents and its name. The slot counts are settings (Commands & Configuration). Lowering them never drops items: the ones past the new count are kept out of sight until it goes back up, and an open bag closes when its slot count changes.

Everything else, the battle lock and keeping it on death, is the same at every tier.

docs.title: Sorting and slot locks
docs.text:
From the Leather Explorer Bag up, a row under the pocket has:

  • Sort: sorts this pocket.
  • Sort all: sorts every pocket.
  • The order: click to change it between ID, Category (creative-tab group, then id) and Count. Right-clicking Sort or Sort all changes it too.

Sorting merges partial stacks first, then orders them. Shift + right-click a slot to lock it, shown with a small padlock: sorting never touches a locked slot. Each player's order is saved with the world.

An operator can turn sorting and locks off for everyone with /satchel config sort enabled false.

docs.title: On your back
docs.text:
Wear the satchel in the Accessories back slot and, in third person and for every other player, each tier is a different 3D bag: a small canvas pouch, a leather pack with a bedroll, the Ultra pack with its cyan emblem. It sits over a chestplate and follows sneaking. No GeckoLib needed.

  • Dyeing: put any tier and dyes in the crafting grid, like leather armour. The cloth takes the colour; the pockets keep everything.
  • Cosmetic slot (Ultra Satchel only): to the right of the pocket grid. Put a banner or a Poké Ball there (any item tagged cobblemon_trainers_satchel:cosmetic) and that is what your back shows instead of the bag, with the same pockets and slots. Take it out and the bag comes back.

/satchel config cosmetics enabled false draws no bag on the back and hides the slot; what is in it stays.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: If yours is not here, post it in the Discord: it files the ticket for you.

docs.title: The game will not start and names a mod
docs.text: One of the requirements is missing or older than the satchel needs, usually Accessories. The message says which and which version; install that one.

docs.title: An item bounces back from a pocket
docs.text: That pocket does not take it. Check where it belongs in the Rules button's list: (tag) means the pocket tags decide, ▸ means an operator's rule does. An operator can send the item to another pocket (Pockets & Rules).

docs.title: A pocket is greyed out
docs.text: You are in a Cobblemon battle (or a Cobblemon Action Combat fight): Agriculture, Architect and Materials are closed until it ends (In Battle & in the Field).

docs.title: Something comes back with "past the cap"
docs.text: An operator set battle balls_per_battle or items_per_battle. The count starts again with the next battle.

docs.title: Right-clicking the PC does not ask anything
docs.text: pc_storage is switched off on the server, so the PC opens straight to Cobblemon's PC (PC Item Storage).

docs.title: My Soul Link partner and I do not see the same PC storage
docs.text: Sharing needs Cobblemon Nuzlocke on the server and pc_storage soul_link_shared on (it is by default), and you must be in the same Soul Link. If you left the link your storage starts empty, and the shared one stays with the others (PC Item Storage).

docs.title: The belt is not refilled
docs.text: The refill needs PokeBelt (Fabric only), the satchel worn on your back and an Explorer Bag or better, and it only refills with a ball of the same kind you just threw (PokeBelt refill).

docs.title: My items disappeared after lowering the slots
docs.text: They did not: items past the new slot count are hidden, not deleted. Raise the setting again and they return (Tiers).

docs.title: The config file did not take my change
docs.text: Use /satchel config on a live server (Commands & Configuration). A file that is not valid JSON is left as it is, and the settings in force stay.
